result.title: Latent Cluster Separation as a Regularizer for Lifelong Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Lifelong (continual) anomaly detection systems must learn a sequence of tasks without forgetting how to recognize anomaly types seen earlier -- a property known as backward transfer. A common way to try to improve backward transfer is to reshape a model's internal representation around learnable concept centroids, typically coupled with a new way of scoring anomalies based on distance to those centroids. Because these two design choices are usually introduced together, it is unclear which one is actually responsible for any performance gain. In this paper, we unbundle the two mechanisms within a VAE-based lifelong anomaly detector and study them separately. We find that used purely as a training-time regularizer -- while leaving anomaly scoring unchanged -- latent cluster separation can improve detection quality and backward transfer, though whether it outperforms the alternative scoring approach depends on the dataset's underlying representation. Switching to distance-based scoring is instead where most of the instability commonly associated with this class of method actually originates; we identify and explain the underlying mechanism. This benefit depends on the dataset's underlying representation, and we report this as practical guidance for choosing between the two design choices, rather than as a list of caveats.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在基于 VAE 的终身/持续异常检测器中解耦两种常被捆绑的设计——围绕可学习概念质心重塑内部表示，以及按到质心距离进行异常打分——分别考察其对检测质量与后向迁移的作用，发现仅作训练期正则时仍可提升检测与后向迁移，而距离打分才是该类方法不稳定性的主要来源，并给出机制解释与选择建议。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「训练期 latent 正则」与「推理期读出方式」分开消融、做贡献归因的做法，可能为 LVR 中区分 latent 状态训练的收益与答案读出/打分机制的影响提供可核查的方法线索，也涉及潜在表示几何与状态组织；但研究对象为单模态异常检测，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。
